# Eurostat German ICT-training fixture: separate reuse notice

Source: Eurostat, dataset [isoc_ske_ittn2](https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/databrowser/view/isoc_ske_ittn2/default/table?lang=en), accessed 8 October 2026.

The file `de-ict-training.json` is the exact 3,506-byte filtered statistical-data response, SHA-256 `dab0f8f8f445839ac883543729ebb006118de10dc5893b9a1bed77bddf640c61`. Selection: Germany (`DE`), annual (`A`), 10 or more employed persons (`GE10`), `C10-S951_X_K`, `E_ITT2`, percentage of enterprises (`PC_ENT`). It contains 10 survey-year cells, not enterprise or individual records. `manifest.json` is pdoom.live provenance metadata, not an upstream file.

Reuse of this selected German statistical-data slice is governed by [Eurostat's statistical-data and metadata reuse policy](https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/web/main/help/copyright-notice), with source attribution. This is distinct from the editorial website's CC BY license. The EU-country selection has no identified item-specific third-party or trade-data exception. Do not extend this determination to other artifacts or every geography. Retain applicable exceptions and check rights afresh before widening scope.

This fixture is outside `data/` and its CC0 dedication. It is not relicensed under CC0 or the repository software license. The raw response is unchanged; its upstream population selection is described above. Reader outputs are normalized adaptations by pdoom.live, with observation keys, explicit missingness, reference-year documentation and comparability annotations added. Eurostat is not responsible for these adaptations and does not endorse them.

No underlying job advertisements, respondent records, third-party source programs or broad archive are included.
